name: Winterhoof Cleansing
summary: The Winterhoof Water Well in Mulgore has been fouled. Mull Thunderhorn gives you a consecrated totem in Bloodhoof Village to cleanse it. Goblin operations have tainted the nearby springs, and clearing this well is the first step toward healing central Mulgore’s waters.

sections.title: A Land Despoiled
sections.body: Mulgore’s grassy plains rely on ancestral wells to sustain wild game and scattered tauren tribes. The Venture Company has recently brought its industrial mercenaries into the hills southeast of Bloodhoof Village. Their work has contaminated local aquifers and left the Winterhoof Water Well toxic. Wild beasts avoid its water, and nearby camps face danger if the corruption spreads through the earth.

sections.title: The Ritual of Purifying Waters
sections.body: Mull Thunderhorn carves a cleansing totem and blesses it in the name of the Earth Mother. Armed Venture Company goons have claimed the spring, so you must brave them to reach the well. Set the totem at its head, and it will drive out the foul runoff. Then clean water can rise from deep within the earth.

faq.q: Where is the Winterhoof Water Well located?
faq.answer: The Winterhoof Water Well lies in the hills southeast of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. Goblin laborers and Venture Company mercenaries patrol nearby.

faq.q: Why was the water well poisoned?
faq.answer: The Venture Company began mining and excavation nearby. Toxic runoff and refuse seeped into the aquifer, making the spring unsafe for local wildlife and tauren to drink.
Mull Thunderhorn is a spiritual elder in Bloodhoof Village who is deeply attuned to the earth’s health. He crafts ceremonial totems to undo the harm wrought by outside invaders.

faq.q: What happens after the well is cleansed?
faq.answer: After the Winterhoof Water Well runs clear and wildlife can drink safely, Mull Thunderhorn sends you to other troubled wells in Mulgore, beginning with the Thunderhorn Totem.

faq.q: Who are the guards at the well?
aliases: what enemies are at the well
faq.answer: The well is held by laborers and hirelings employed by the Venture Company. This goblin-led syndicate strips natural resources from the land without regard for the local ecosystem.

faq.q: How does the cleansing totem work?
faq.answer: Carved with sacred tauren rites and wards, the totem draws on natural spirits and the Earth Mother’s blessings to purge unnatural chemical pollutants from the spring’s source.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know Mulgore’s wells as sacred gifts from the Earth Mother that give life. Protecting them from goblin greed is both a duty to your people and a holy obligation.
As a shaman, you channel spirits through totems to cleanse industrial corruption and honor your bond with the elemental waters.
As a druid, you see thirsty wildlife return to the cleansed spring. Their return shows why nature needs healing wherever civilization threatens it.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure fresh water for the tauren heartland, a southern pillar of the young Horde.
